items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I met her, but I didn't actually interview her.

ctx.x: Did you interview her? Did you meet her?
I met her, but I didn't actually interview her. Uh-huh. Uh, I went with somebody who was interviewing her, but I can't remember who it was.
Oh, but, but she was interviewing her?
